biology, which broadens my ability to integrate IT knowledge into
more specialized professional fields. My time management and
organizational skills have been honed through my experience as a
freelancer, where I consistently deliver high-quality work on time.
Looking ahead, I am eager to develop professional programming
skills to become a full-stack developer, enhancing my web design
expertise. I also aspire to pursue further education abroad, where I
can continue to grow academically and contribute meaningfully to
social aspects, primarily by supporting the enhancement of economic
cycles.
I am eager to further develop my skills and explore opportunities that
allow me to merge my interests in technology, design, and biology
into impactful projects.
